title: Drive 'Em Down, the roving piano player
summary: Nash knew the pianist Drive 'Em Down, who played in any honky-tonk with a piano and hung out at Liberty and Perdido.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Do you remember driving him down a piano player? Yeah.
I know him. Where does he play?
Drive him down anywhere that had a hunker-tonk, that's where he played. Anywhere where piano was. Sure had no drive him down.
You didn't have any one special place you hung around?

Well, I tell you where his band hang out was. Living in Padida. That's right. Let me see. Living in Padida. Living in Padida, plank and gravity. Yeah, Living in Padida. That's your band hang out. Drive him down. I knew him good. And that...
Well, I don't see him anymore. I heard this other fella die in two stormy weather. Yeah, he died. He died, huh?
